opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari granted and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 79-1056, Northwest Airlines, Inc. v. Transport Workers Union of America, AFL-CIO, et al., immediately infra.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
